archive.description: lossless: full backup — complete tool outputs, faithful JSON, memory files (heavy)

quick.description: lossless: light daily backup — truncated tool outputs + faithful JSON (fast, compact)

study.description: lossy: transcript (tool output truncated) + memory corpus (medium)

review.description: lossless: transcript without reasoning + faithful JSON (does not redact)

notes.description: lossy: plain read — every message, tool output truncated to ~500 chars, patches and reasoning kept (light)

conversation.description: lossy: user + assistant text only — no tools, patches or reasoning (light)

prompts.description: lossy: only user prompts — no answers/reasoning/tools (task log)

rag.description: lossy: one JSON line per root session with tokens, first ask, last answer, todos, tools and digests (summary)

digest.description: lossy: only the compaction summaries (knowledge arc)
